lines.text: This winter... the furnace died... at two A.M.
It's freezing in here. Is anyone there? Please... pick up.
Voicemail. Silence. The longest night of the year.
Hi, you've reached the after-hours line. No heat at all? Okay. I've marked this urgent and alerted the on-call tech. They'll text you shortly.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Never miss a 2 A.M. emergency again. DM us PLAN. You're still the captain.
